item.title: Qckupdate
item.description: I’m currently about halfway through Endymion and there was something really fun/interesting that I picked up on when I first started reading it. As you may know (or not), I am 26 years old as of writing this. I am working at some whatever jobs doing fuck all and just living my life. Interestingly, Raul (the protagonist of the book) at the beginning is just some 27 year old dude who was living his life. For some reason, that really resonated with me. Even though, Raul is not real and the story is just some made up bullshit some guy thought would be cool to write down. It resonated.
